correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the 9-point 12-line rank-three matroid and 72 noncollinear triangles. A rank-28 boundary map with an explicit determinant -1 minor proves integral H2=Z^44 and H1=0. Exact 43x43 determinant -1 in the 44x54 cap matrix plus the normalized area map with values (0:32,6:6,-6:6) on an integral homology basis proves cap span primitive, rank43, and quotient Z. Checked all432 affine maps for determinant-sign action, all54 caps for area cancellation, and triangle-support minimality combinatorially. See verify.py and verification_output.txt.

value.rationale: The natural smallest ternary affine plane has 54 maximal caps, all minimal geometric 2-spheres. Proving their span is primitive yet codimension one isolates a mathematically motivated obstruction not apparent from the ordinary Betti number, and gives an explicit affine-orientation character for the missing class. This addresses integral generation by simplest geometric cycles, rather than an arbitrary narrow invariant.
